resume: After a separation: insure the new home before you get the keys, notify the old home's insurer within 15 days, cancel at no cost and check that the children remain covered.
aQuoiCaSert: When you leave the family home, you need both to deal with the old home insurance (assurance habitation) contract and to insure the new home. A tenant must at least be insured against tenant's risks (risques locatifs); otherwise the landlord can terminate the lease or take out insurance at their own expense and charge it back to the tenant. It is also the time to check your civil liability cover (responsabilité civile), often included in the home insurance contract, which covers damage caused by the children.
quiEstConcerne: The parent who moves after a separation, whether a tenant or an owner.
The parent who stays in the home and needs to adapt the contract.
Both parents, to check that the children have civil liability cover at each parent's home.
aSavoir: Tenant: only insurance against tenant's risks (fire, explosion, water damage) is compulsory. Give the certificate to the landlord when you get the keys, then every year if they ask for it.

Without insurance, the landlord can ask for the lease to be terminated if the lease provides for it. After a registered letter giving you 1 month to get insured, the landlord can also take out insurance on your behalf and charge you the premium plus up to 10%; they can then no longer ask for termination on this ground.
Moving: notify your insurer before you leave or at the latest within 15 calendar days after leaving the home, by registered letter or registered electronic mail.

Cancellation because of a move: possible if the change of home alters the insured risks. Send the letter no later than 3 months after leaving, explaining the link with the move. The contract ends 1 month after the insurer receives it.
No cancellation fee can be charged because of a move, and premiums paid for the period after cancellation must be refunded to you.
You can also transfer the contract to the new home if the insurer agrees, by amendment (avenant); the premium may then change.

etapes.titre: Insure the new home before you get the keys
etapes.detail: The landlord will ask for the certificate on move-in day.
For moving in: insurance certificate printed or on your phone, ID, signed lease. For the insurer: contract number, new address, floor area, move-in date.
Before leaving or within the following 15 days. Cancel no later than 3 months after leaving if you wish.
Check with the insurer how to remove a name or take out a new contract, so the parent who stays is properly covered.

etapes.titre: Check the children's civil liability cover
etapes.detail: Make sure the children remain covered when they are at your home, under your contract or the other parent's, and share the certificates.
Store the letter and the acknowledgment of receipt in the Vault.
